notes.title: Army of Ruin - Available now!
notes.content:
[h2]Today we're releasing the 1.0 version of Army of Ruin![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019091/4240571054a715b5afcdc45b6f942c3942b126e8.png[/img]


During the past 8 months we've been in Early Access, we've released [b]over 25 updates[/b] adding lots of new content and features, such as [b]24 playable charactes[/b], [b]over 100 weapons and evolutions[/b], and [b]over 60 different trinkets[/b], many of which were based on the community feedback we've got during the whole process.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1918040/extras/ArmyOfRuin_GameplayGif.gif?t=1666864737[/img]

We believe Army of Ruin has become a great game with lots of contents to unlock and lots of fun to have while doing so, and we hope you think the same way, whether you are a new player or a returning backer!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6860297/d27102d66ff5f2301f2d0992186536fb5b1ccebb.jpg[/img]

As always, we're eager to hear suggestions and feedback for future content, be it in the Steam forums, in the official Subreddit, or in the official Discord server!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6860297/e34529c4f4f82c9801c8fd26db52b37d81ab5cfa.jpg[/img]

We're also releasing the official Soundtrack and new bundles to get the game combined with other items (such as our previous games) at a reduced price.

The game will have a 10% discount for the following 10 days, and you can get additional discounts with the themed bundles, such as the Army of Ruin + Soundtrack bundle or Milkstone Complete Collection bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1918040/Army_of_Ruin/

notes.title: OSX/Linux update
notes.content:
Hi!

Thanks to the help of Ethan Lee "flibitijibibo" , we've released an updated version of Little Racers STREET that should work out of the box with modern versions of OSX and Linux distributions, without any workaround required.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Bugfix update - online issues
notes.content:
Welcome back fellow speed maniacs, it's been a while (2 years since the last patch)!

We've just uploaded a small bugfix update that should help with a specific issue regarding not being able to join online sessions, as well as another one regarding getting stuck in the car selection screen when joining an online game and not having a car for the required class.

notes.title: Complete your Milkstone Studios Collection with this offer!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce the Milkstone Studios Collection!

With this, you'll be able to get [b]our full Steam game catalog at a 25% discount[/b]. The games you already have are left out, so the price is lower. Moreover, this will be compatible with another offers, so no excuses for getting all of our games at a low price! :)

This collection includes all games released by Milkstone Studios on Steam: 

[list]
[*]Race your way to the top in the fast-paced top-down racing game [b]Little Racers Street[/b]
[*]Take you and your partners into a fresh combination of cooperation and horror on [b]White Noise Online[/b]
[*]Face the many challenges and dangers on the dungeon crawling FPS [b]Ziggurat[/b]
[*]Survive the dangers of an unforgiving Ancient Egypt in [b]Pharaonic[/b]
[/list]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/460]Get the full collection here![/url]

notes.title: Little Racers Street Updated
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*]1st attempt to fix some crashes when loading achievement textures
[*]1st attempt to fix people appearing in lobby twice (and all the bugs associated with that). We haven't been able to reproduce so don't set your expectations too high about this :(
[*]Improved minimap colors, now online players are shown in their primary color, and lapped players are shown darker.
[*]Moved fences in Isla Grande to match collision bounds
[*]Texts while racing (Nitro, wrong way, etc) are properly shown after changing camera
[/list]
